label: Rejected Joseon Neo-Confucian chastity and three-obediences ideology as dehumanizing to women
description: In Gyeonghui and A Confession About My Divorce, Na dismantled the Joseon Neo-Confucian ideal of the "wise mother, good wife" as an instrument of male domination.
dialecticalTension: Pits modern existential personhood against Neo-Confucian ritual gender hierarchy.

label: Engaged Yosano Akiko’s Tokyo feminist circle while studying art in Japan
description: Studying in Tokyo in the 1910s, Na drew inspiration from Yosano Akiko and the Seito movement while forging an autonomous Korean anti-colonial feminist voice.
dialecticalTension: Cross-pollinates Taisho and Korean feminist philosophies of love and self-expression.
